parameters.name: ApplicationConfigs
parameters.description: The application configurations. The number of array elements N can range from 1 to 1000.

parameters.name: Applications
parameters.description: The list of applications. The number of array elements N can range from 1 to 100.

parameters.name: BootstrapScripts
parameters.description: The array of bootstrap scripts. The number of array elements N can range from 1 to 10.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Multiple calls with the same client token return the same result and create only one cluster.

parameters.name: ClusterName
parameters.description: The cluster name. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with http\:// or https\://. It can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), periods (.), or hyphens (-).

parameters.name: ClusterType
parameters.description:
The cluster type. Valid values:

- DATALAKE: new data lake.

- OLAP: data analytics.

- DATAFLOW: real-time data stream.

- DATASERVING: DataService Studio.

- CUSTOM: custom cluster.

- HADOOP: legacy data lake. This value is not recommended. Use the new data lake cluster type instead.

If you create an EMR cluster for the first time after 17:00 (UTC+8) on December 19, 2022, you cannot select HADOOP, DATA\_SCIENCE, PRESTO, or ZOOKEEPER as the cluster type.

parameters.name: DeletionProtection
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable deletion protection for the cluster. Valid values:

- true: Enables deletion protection.

- false: Disables deletion protection.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: DeployMode
parameters.description:
The deployment mode of applications in the cluster. Valid values:

- NORMAL (default): non-high availability deployment. The cluster has one master node.

- HA: high availability (HA) deployment. This deployment mode requires at least three master nodes.

parameters.name: NodeAttributes
parameters.description: The node attributes. These are the basic attributes of all ECS nodes in the cluster.

parameters.name: NodeGroups
parameters.description: The array of node group configurations. The number of array elements N can range from 1 to 100.

parameters.name: PaymentType
parameters.description:
The billing method. Valid values:

- PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go.

- Subscription: subscription.

Default value: PayAsYouGo.

parameters.name: ReleaseVersion
parameters.description: The EMR release version. You can find the EMR release version on the EMR cluster purchase page.

parameters.name: SecurityMode
parameters.description:
The Kerberos security mode of the cluster. Valid values:

- NORMAL (default): normal mode. Kerberos is disabled.

- KERBEROS: Kerberos mode. Kerberos is enabled.

parameters.name: SubscriptionConfig
parameters.description: The subscription configurations. This parameter is required if you set PaymentType to Subscription.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The tags. The number of array elements N can range from 0 to 20.
